value.rationale: Gives all intermediate rooted 1-WL equivalence classes and an exact sharp refinement-depth invariant for an unbounded two-parameter family of vertex-transitive cycle-power graphs. The wavefront advances exactly k distance shells per round after initiation; at n=4k an antipodal collision makes R=3 whereas n=4k+1 gives R=2. These exact structural and logical thresholds are not routine re-labelings or isolated small examples. No general isomorphism identification is claimed.
